name: BLST — BLPA Live Scoring
description: Live scoring and stat tracking for BLPA hockey tournaments, with an iPad-friendly scorekeeper and public live scoreboards.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Admin password for the web app. Auto-generated: find it later under Settings → Reveal Config Vars.

SEED_DEMO.description: "true" loads a demo tournament (4 teams, 2 finished games, 1 live game) on first deploy so you can try things out. Delete it from Admin → Settings when you're done.

PUBLIC_EXPORTS.description: "true" lets anyone call the export API (like the public scoreboards). "false" requires an API key.

FACTIONS_BASE_URL.description: Optional: URL of your BLPA Factions app, e.g. https://your-factions-app.herokuapp.com

FACTIONS_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Optional: the BLPA Factions app's ADMIN_TOKEN.

FACTIONS_AUTO_SYNC.description: Optional: "true" pushes results to Factions automatically after every final.
